title: SlideTimelineSchema
description: Output contract for the Slide Extraction stage. Lists every slide occurrence in chronological order.

slides.description: Chronologically ordered slide occurrences. May be empty if no slides were detected.

slide_id.description: Stable identifier shared by all occurrences of the same unique slide (e.g. 's001').

start_seconds.description: Playback time when this slide appeared.

end_seconds.description: Playback time when this slide was replaced or the recording ended.

frame_path.description: Relative path (from cache root) to the representative JPEG frame for this occurrence.

frame_hash.description: 64-bit pHash hex string of the representative frame. Used for slide de-duplication.

frame_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the frame image bytes. Used as vision model cache key.
